quests.instruction: Which word means your mother plus your father, added together?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: Think of the two grown-ups directly raising you.
quests.explanation: Parents means your mother plus your father together.
quests.funFact: Many languages have a single word just like 'parents' that means mom and dad together!

quests.instruction: Which family member group is two generations above you in a family tree?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: This group includes both a grandmother and a grandfather.
quests.explanation: Grandparents are two generations above you on a family tree.
quests.funFact: A family tree branches out wider and wider as you go back through the generations!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the mother of your mother or your father?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: This family member is a generation above your parents.
quests.explanation: Grandmother is the mother of your mother or your father.
quests.funFact: Grandmothers are called different loving names in different families, like Nana, Gran, or Meemaw!

quests.instruction: Which word means the people who share your home life and daily routines?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word describes the whole household of relatives, not just one relationship.
quests.explanation: Family means the people who share your home life and daily routines with you.
quests.funFact: Sharing meals together is one tradition that many families around the world enjoy!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the father of either your mom or your dad?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: Think of the man who raised your mother or your father.
quests.explanation: Grandfather is the father of either your mom or your dad.
quests.funFact: A grandfather might live nearby, or he might live far away and call on the phone!

quests.instruction: Which word describes your mother and father together?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: This word combines the two grown-ups who are directly raising you.
quests.explanation: Parents is the word for your mother and father together.
quests.funFact: The word 'parent' can describe a mother, a father, or both together!

quests.instruction: Which word describes your grandmother and grandfather together?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: This word combines the two oldest people in your close family.
quests.explanation: Grandparents is the word for your grandmother and grandfather together.
quests.funFact: Some children have more grandparents than others, since each parent can have up to two!

quests.instruction: Which family member has grown-up children who became parents themselves?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: This family member is a woman with a grown son or daughter.
quests.explanation: Grandmother has a grown-up child, like your mother or father, who became a parent themselves.
quests.funFact: Many grandmothers say being a grandparent is one of life's greatest joys!

quests.instruction: Which word do you use for everyone who lives together and loves and supports each other?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word can include parents, siblings, and grandparents all at once.
quests.explanation: Family is the word for everyone who lives together and loves and supports each other.
quests.funFact: Every family has its own special traditions that make it unique!

quests.instruction: Which family member often has grown-up children who became parents themselves, and is a man?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: This family member is a man with a grown son or daughter.
quests.explanation: Grandfather has a grown-up child, like your mother or father, who became a parent themselves.
quests.funFact: Many grandfathers enjoy passing down old family tools, watches, or keepsakes!

quests.instruction: Which family member group is one generation directly above you on a family tree?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: This group is the very first branch directly above yours.
quests.explanation: Parents are one generation directly above you on a family tree.
quests.funFact: On a family tree, a child is always drawn directly below their own parents!

quests.instruction: Which family member group sits one branch higher than your parents on a family tree?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: This group includes a grandmother and grandfather together.
quests.explanation: Grandparents sit one branch higher than your parents on a family tree.
quests.funFact: Many families enjoy making a scrapbook together with photos of grandparents from years ago!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a grandparent who is a woman?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She is your mom or dad's own mother.
quests.explanation: Grandmother is the grandparent in the family who is a woman.
quests.funFact: Grandmothers around the world often love spending time baking or gardening with grandchildren!

quests.instruction: Which word means a group of people connected by parents, children, and other relatives?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word can include many generations at once.
quests.explanation: Family means a group of people connected by parents, children, and other relatives.
quests.funFact: Family trees help show how every single family member is connected to each other!

quests.instruction: Which family member do many children call 'Grandpa' or 'Pop'?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He is older than your mother or father.
quests.explanation: Grandfather is often called 'Grandpa' or 'Pop' by children.
quests.funFact: A grandfather often loves sharing memories about what the world was like long ago!

quests.instruction: Which family member group is directly above you, one generation up, on a family tree?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: This group is your mom and dad, the very closest branch above yours.
quests.explanation: Parents are directly above you, one generation up, on a family tree.
quests.funFact: A simple family tree often starts with just parents and children before growing bigger!

quests.instruction: Which word means the parents of your own parents?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: Think one generation above your mom and dad.
quests.explanation: Grandparents means the parents of your own mother and father.
quests.funFact: Everyone in the world has grandparents, even if they never got to meet them!

quests.instruction: Which family member is older than your parents and is a woman?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She is the parent of one of your parents.
quests.explanation: Grandmother is a woman who is older than your parents, since she is their parent.
quests.funFact: Grandmothers sometimes teach their grandchildren favorite family recipes!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a mom, a dad, kids, and other relatives, all considered together?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word is the biggest umbrella term for all these people together.
quests.explanation: Family describes a mom, dad, kids, and other relatives, all considered together as one group.
quests.funFact: Around the world, the exact people who count as 'family' can look a little different from place to place!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a grandparent who is a man?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He is your mom or dad's own father.
quests.explanation: Grandfather is the grandparent in the family who is a man.
quests.funFact: Grandfathers around the world often love spending time on hobbies like woodworking or chess!

quests.instruction: Which family member group are you the child of?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: This group is your mother and father.
quests.explanation: Parents are the family member group that you are the child of.
quests.funFact: The word 'child' describes any son or daughter, from a parent's point of view!

quests.instruction: Which family member group often loves spoiling their grandchildren with treats and stories?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: This group is one generation older than your mom and dad.
quests.explanation: Grandparents often love spoiling their grandchildren with treats and wonderful stories.
quests.funFact: Studies show that spending time with grandparents can make children feel extra loved and secure!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your parent's own mother?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She is the woman your mom or dad calls 'Mom'.
quests.explanation: Grandmother is your parent's own mother.
quests.funFact: Your mom or dad was once a child, just like you, being raised by their own mother!

quests.instruction: Which word means the people who love and take care of each other as relatives?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word can describe your whole group of relatives together.
quests.explanation: Family means the people who love and take care of each other as relatives.
quests.funFact: A strong family often means having people who help each other through both good times and hard times!

quests.instruction: In a family tree, which family member is drawn two levels above you, as a man?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He is your mother's or father's father.
quests.explanation: Grandfather is drawn two levels above you on a family tree, as a man.
quests.funFact: Looking at old family trees can be like reading a story about your whole family's past!

quests.instruction: Which word do you use to talk about your mom and dad as a pair?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: It is the plural word naming two specific people.
quests.explanation: Parents is the word used to talk about your mom and dad as a pair.
quests.funFact: Some children have two parents at home, and every family's story looks a little different!

quests.instruction: Which family member group are you the grandchild of?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: This group is your parents' own parents.
quests.explanation: Grandparents are the family member group that you are the grandchild of.
quests.funFact: The word 'grandchild' describes any child of your children, from a grandparent's point of view!

quests.instruction: Which family member has been part of the family for the longest time, along with grandfather?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She belongs to the oldest generation in your close family.
quests.explanation: Grandmother has been part of the family for a very long time, often along with grandfather.
quests.funFact: Grandmothers often have the most family photos saved from many years ago!

quests.instruction: Which word means the people you are related to, whether by birth or by marriage?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word covers relatives connected in more than one way.
quests.explanation: Family means the people you are related to, whether by birth or by marriage.
quests.funFact: When two people marry, their two families sometimes become connected as one bigger family!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the man one generation above your mother or father?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: Think about who your mom or dad calls their own father.
quests.explanation: Grandfather is one generation above your mother or father on the family tree.
quests.funFact: On a family tree, grandfathers are usually drawn two levels above their grandchildren!
